hook.en: When the owner of a shop takes ₹2,000 from the counter for his son's fees, is it a business expense? The basic concepts answer such questions.
hook.kn: ಅಂಗಡಿ ಮಾಲೀಕ ಮಗನ ಶುಲ್ಕಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ಗಲ್ಲಾದಿಂದ ₹2,000 ತೆಗೆದರೆ ಅದು ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ವೆಚ್ಚವೇ? ಮೂಲಭೂತ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆಗಳು ಇಂತಹ ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡುತ್ತವೆ.

objectives.en: Explain business entity, money measurement, going concern, accounting period, cost and dual aspect concepts

narration.en: When the owner of a shop takes ₹2,000 from the counter for his son's fees, is it a business expense? The basic concepts answer such questions.

title.en: Business entity, money measurement and going concern

body.en: Business entity: the business is separate from its owner, so the owner's personal transactions are not recorded and capital is treated as a liability to the owner. Money measurement: only transactions that can be expressed in money are recorded. Going concern: the business is assumed to continue for a long time, so assets are shown at cost less depreciation and not at their sale value.
body.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಘಟಕ: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಮಾಲೀಕರಿಂದ ಪ್ರತ್ಯೇಕ. ಹಣದ ಅಳತೆ: ಹಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಳೆಯಬಹುದಾದವನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ದಾಖಲಿಸುವುದು. ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ: ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ದೀರ್ಘಕಾಲ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂಬ ಊಹೆ.

title.en: Accounting period, cost and dual aspect

body.en: Accounting period: the life of the business is divided into periods, usually one year (in India 1 April to 31 March), to measure profit and position regularly. Cost concept: assets are recorded at the price paid to acquire them, including expenses to bring them into use. Dual aspect: every transaction has two equal aspects, which gives the accounting equation Assets = Liabilities + Capital.
body.kn: ಲೆಕ್ಕಾವಧಿ: ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಒಂದು ವರ್ಷ (ಏಪ್ರಿಲ್ 1 ರಿಂದ ಮಾರ್ಚ್ 31). ವೆಚ್ಚ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕೊಂಡ ಬೆಲೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ದಾಖಲಿಸುವುದು. ದ್ವಿಮುಖ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಪ್ರತಿ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಕ್ಕೂ ಎರಡು ಸಮಾನ ಮುಖಗಳಿವೆ.

problem.en: Suresh bought a machine for ₹1,80,000, paid ₹8,000 freight and ₹12,000 for installation. A year later a dealer offers ₹2,50,000 for it. At what amount is the machine recorded, and which concept applies?

steps.en: The dealer's offer is ignored: under the cost concept (and going concern) the machine stays at cost less depreciation.

points.en: Business entity: owner and business are separate.

points.kn: ಹಣದ ಅಳತೆ: ಹಣದ ವ್ಯವಹಾರಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾತ್ರ ದಾಖಲಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Going concern and cost concept: assets at cost less depreciation.
points.kn: ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿರುವ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆ ಮತ್ತು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಪರಿಕಲ್ಪನೆ: ಆಸ್ತಿಗಳು ವೆಚ್ಚ ಕಳೆ ಸವಕಳಿ.
